# Accepted NuGet security advisories.
#
# The vulnerable-NuGet gate (jonnymuir/ci-security) fails CI on any High/Critical
# advisory that is NOT listed here. An entry is a deliberate, reviewed decision to ship
# a known-vulnerable dependency for a stated reason, with a condition for removing it.
#
# Format: one advisory id (GHSA-… or CVE-…) at the start of the line, then a '#' and a
# short reason including WHEN to revisit. Blank lines and full-line comments are ignored.
#
# Example:
#   GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx  # <pkg> <ver>: compile-time only, no untrusted input reaches it.
#                        # Revisit when <upstream> ships a fix (tracking: <link>).
#
# SixLabors.ImageSharp 3.1.12 arrives transitively through Umbraco CMS imaging, in the reference
# app and the integration tests only: the published Wayfinder.Umbraco package does not depend on
# it, so hosts take whichever version their own Umbraco brings. The fixes ship only in 4.1.2+,
# a major version that needs a paid Six Labors license and that Umbraco 17 is not built against,
# so we leave the upgrade to Umbraco rather than override its dependency. Accepted 2026-10-12
# (same decision as Umbraco.Prism, 2026-10-10); revisit when Umbraco ships a release on a
# patched ImageSharp. Nothing in this repo's source references ImageSharp, histogram
# equalization or TIFF encoding.
#
# The two Moderate ImageSharp advisories (GHSA-gwg2-r3hj-4w44 ICC CLUT parsing, GHSA-wmxv-xphr-5c9g
# BigTIFF decoder loop) are not gated and the reference app does decode visitor-uploaded images,
# so they are reachable there. Both are denial-of-service class, not code execution. The gate only
# blocks High/Critical; the known AngleSharp 0.17.1 Moderate advisory, via HtmlSanitizer, is
# likewise reported but not blocking.

GHSA-j3p4-wp97-rph4  # HistogramEqualization: an image processor nothing in this repo invokes.
GHSA-j9gm-c75j-xc9q  # TIFF CCITT T4 encoder: only reached when writing TIFF; nothing here encodes TIFF.
GHSA-jjfr-hcj7-qf5w  # TIFF CCITT T6 encoder: same as above.
GHSA-v76p-62qx-wwq2  # Tiled CCITT fax TIFF decoder heap overflow: reachable only by decoding a tiled fax TIFF. Accepted 2026-10-26 with the others; revisit with them when Umbraco ships patched ImageSharp.
